name: Lianainao (恋爱脑)
blurb: Chinese slang for a "love brain": someone who loses all judgment when in love
title: Lianainao (恋爱脑) Meaning: Chinese Slang for "Love Brain"
description: 恋爱脑 ("love brain") is someone who puts romance above everything and loses judgment once in love. Internet slang, not a diagnosis. Signs and examples.
answer: 恋爱脑 (liàn'àinǎo, literally "love brain") is a mindset fixated on romance: once in a relationship, a person pours all their time and thoughts into their partner, puts love above everything and loses judgment and sense of self. It also means a person like that. It is usually teasing or critical, as in 别恋爱脑了 ("stop being so love-brained"). It is recent internet slang, not a medical or psychological diagnosis.

ul: one message from the partner decides your mood for the whole day
giving up study, work, friends or plans for them
everyone can see the problem, but you keep making excuses for them
deciding "this is the one" after knowing someone a few weeks
forgiving every hurt as soon as they are nice again

body: Caring deeply is not the same thing. The point of the word is losing your own judgment and limits.

ul: 「他说下个月就还钱，我又信了，我真是恋爱脑。」 (He said he'd pay me back next month and I believed him again. I'm so love-brained.)
「醒醒，别恋爱脑了，他三天没回你消息了。」 (Wake up, he hasn't replied in three days.)
「这部剧的女主太恋爱脑了。」 (The heroine in this drama is way too love-brained.)
「谈恋爱可以，恋爱脑不行。」 (Dating is fine; a love brain is not.)

body: There is a whole "anti-love-brain" (反恋爱脑) trend online, with quotes meant to "slap a love brain awake".

head: Term
Meaning
Difference
rows: a mindset; the love may be mutual
keeps pleasing someone who isn't interested
a short-lived state, not only about love
about fantasy; 恋爱脑 can be in a real relationship

body: Calling yourself 恋爱脑 is self-mockery; saying it to a friend can be caring or condescending, depending on how you say it. Loving someone wholeheartedly is not a flaw in itself.

body.note: If a relationship leaves you constantly doubting yourself, cut off from friends and family, or kept in place by control and put-downs, that is more than a love brain. See the PUA entry and talk to someone you trust.

faq.q: Is 恋爱脑 a medical condition?
faq.a: No. It is internet slang for being overinvested in love, not a medical or psychological diagnosis.
Mostly, or at least teasing: it suggests love has clouded someone's head. Used about yourself it is usually a joke.
There is no exact one. "Love-struck", "lovesick" or "boy-crazy / girl-crazy" come close; the Chinese term stresses losing judgment and self.
